name: SaaS Starter
description: A full-stack team-projects SaaS foundation with Firebase sessions, scoped organizations, Onyx persistence, optional billing and a private invitation outbox.
useWhen: An authenticated multi-organization SaaS app needs projects, roles, invitations and optional subscriptions
avoidWhen: A public content-only site or separate backend service is the primary requirement
capabilities: Optional Stripe and explicit demo billing
React Email with authenticated encrypted outbox
examplePrompt: Build a shared team workspace with projects, invitations, role permissions and optional subscription billing.

requiredEnvironment: Application Firebase settings and server credentials
Stable invitation encryption key for the outbox
